Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Activity-Based Protein Profiling (ABPP) with fluorophosphonate (FP) probes to enrich for active serine hydrolases. While this is a PTM-like enrichment (covalent modification by probe), it does not map to the specific PTM modifiers provided in the ontology list (e.g., phospho, acetyl, ubiquitin). The base workflow is DDA with TMT isobaric labeling.
